assumptions: Tỷ VND, nghìn tấn. Công ty hư cấu Đồi Cọ. Toy hợp đồng forward cash-settled separate derivative P&L, không hedge accounting. Physical crop sale at spot. Không thuế.

evidence.text: [Harvest] 50 nghìn tấn ngô, bán 45 nghìn tấn spot giá 6 triệu/tấn. Tồn kho đầu kỳ zero. Production cost pool 200 tỷ, homogeneous.
[Forward] Cash-settled short forward 30 nghìn tấn, fixed 6.5 triệu/tấn, settlement spot6. Không giao hàng theo forward, settlement received current year.
[Inventory] NRV hàng còn lại 3.8 triệu/tấn; lower of allocated cost and NRV. No abnormal losses.
[P&L] Selling expense20, admin15, interest8. No other income or cost.
[Cash] Customer collections250, all earned billed, opening AR10. Production cash paid190; selling/admin/interest paid full; no tax.
[Financing] Opening cash25, cash capex30, cash borrowing20, principal repay10. No other flows.
[Policy] Derivative settlement separate from physical sales; inventory cost per output, realized cash hedge gain separate. FCF=CFO less capex, derivative settlement operating.
[Deck] Values all 45k sales at forward6.5, adds forward gain again, claims hedge covers entire harvest.

qas.question: Find physical crop sales consideration on actual spot deliveries.
Find hedge cash settlement from short forward.
Find fraction of harvested tonnes notionally hedged.
Find notional hedge coverage relative to tonnes sold.
Find production cost per tonne in million VND.
Find matched production cost of tonnes sold.
Find closing stock write-down under the stated NRV.
Find closing finished stock carrying value.
Find pretax profit including the separate realized derivative gain.
Reconcile ending customer AR excluding derivative cash settlement.
Find direct operating cash surplus including derivative settlement.
Find closing cash after capital and principal movements.
Why does pricing all physical deliveries at6.5 and adding the forward gain double count the hedge?
qas.answer: All physical sales settle at spot6; only the 30k cash forward creates15 gain. Changing physical price and adding gain misstates scope.

qas.question: Can the forward volume be added to shipped volume to report 75k tonnes sold?
qas.answer: No. It is cash settled, without physical delivery; only45k shipped.

qas.question: Can the derivative's total effectiveness against farm cash-flow risk be established?
qas.answer: No. Need production variability, basis exposure, timing and risk objective beyond this one settlement.

qas.question: Can a next-year forward gain be predicted from current fixed price and spot?
qas.answer: No. Future hedge terms, spot prices and notional are unknown.

assumptions: Tỷ VND. Trường giả lập Vườn Bút. Toy 12-month tuition service with explicit financing fee independent of tuition, scholarships reduce gross price, no tax.

evidence.text: [Cohort] 2.000 students each gross annual fee 60 triệu VND; waiver 10% each. All service delivered by Dec31. No withdrawal.
[Installments] 40% of net tuition paid upfront, remaining60% billed in installments; explicit financing fee4 tỷ earned this year. No opening tuition/fee AR.
[Collection] Upfront cash as stated; installments collected50 tỷ principal and3 financing fee. All remaining rights unconditional.
[Credit] Closing allowance 8% unpaid principal and fee. Opening allowance zero, no writeoff. Charge operating expense.
[Costs] Teaching expense70, central expense25, depreciation8, interest expense4. No other items.
[Cash] Teaching paid68, central25, interest4; capex12, opening cash30, no financing or other movements.
[Policy] Tuition is earned net of waiver; finance income outside operating revenue; ECL separate from scholarship.
[Deck] Uses gross120 revenue, calls waiver12 credit expense, includes installment fee in tuition per student and records entire unpaid balance as bad debt.

qas.question: Find gross annual tuition before the waiver.
Find aggregate tuition waiver amount.
Find earned tuition consideration after scholarships.
Find cash collected upfront on net tuition.
Find tuition installment principal billed after upfront payment.

Find unpaid financing fee receivable.

Why is the tuition waiver not an ECL expense?
qas.answer: It reduces contracted consideration before any receivable exists; credit loss measures collectibility of the net recognized rights.

qas.question: Can unpaid principal14.8 be considered entirely uncollectible?
qas.answer: No. The stipulated allowance is 8% on all closing rights, not a 100% write-off.

qas.question: Can the installment plan's effect on student access or enrollment be quantified?
qas.answer: No. Missing counterfactual enrollment, income and financing behavior data.

assumptions: Triệu USD; nghìn tấn payable. Mỏ hư cấu Đá Trắng. Toy sale on provisional pricing, final assay/price recognized in period when confirmed; final statement overrides provisional. No tax.

evidence.text: [Shipment] 20kt concentrate invoiced provisional payable metal 5kt at $8,000/t, less treatment charge $1m. Customer pays advance30m.
[Final assay] Confirmed payable metal4.8kt, final price $7,500/t. Treatment charge revised1.2m. Final settlement signed before year-end, no other variable consideration.
[Royalty] 3% gross final payable metal value before treatment charge. Paid royalty1m, opening royalty payable zero.
[Cost] Matched production cost24m, selling/admin4m, depreciation outside COGS2m, interest1m. No other expense.
[AR] Opening unrelated customer AR3m, collected2m; current shipment advance30 applied to final invoice. No writeoff or other billings.
[Cash] Current cost paid23, selling/admin4, interest1, royalty1; opening cash8, capex5, no financing.
[Policy] Revenue final price×payable quantity less treatment charge; royalty gross basis. No final settlement cash beyond advance in period.
[Deck] Retains provisional39m revenue, deducts assay adjustment from physical production cost, calculates royalty on net consideration.

qas.question: Can royalty be calculated on 34.8 net invoice under this contract?
qas.answer: No. The explicit base is gross36, before treatment charge.

qas.question: Can the final settlement establish metallurgical recovery for the mine?
qas.answer: No. The assay gives payable metal only; input contained metal and processing recovery are not supplied.

assumptions: Tỷ VND. Utility giả lập Bến Nước. Toy customer-funded network connection recognized as deferred contribution then released over network service life. Own PPE gross. No tax.

evidence.text: [Connection project] Cash construction cost300, customer contribution120 collected upfront. Asset ready July1, useful life10 years. Contribution released over same life; no refund on completion.
[Existing network] Opening PPE700, current depreciation70, no disposals. Existing deferred contributions opening80, current release8.
[Tariff] Metered service revenue500, no new connection fees earned upfront. Cash receipts480, opening tariff AR40, no writeoff.
[Costs] Operating expense320 excluding depreciation, interest25. Cash opex310, interest25 paid. No other expense.
[Financing] Opening cash100, cash borrowing150, principal repayment30. No other cash flows; connection construction classified investing.
[Policy] New contributions cash classified investing inflow under toy, deferred release other operating income. PPE depreciation gross, do not offset contribution against cost.
[Covenant] Net cash capex defined gross connection spend less received customer contribution; FCF adjusted=CFO minus net cash capex.
[Deck] Recognizes120 upfront as service revenue, nets it against PPE300 and additionally records deferred release.

qas.answer: No. No incremental customer volumes, tariff changes or operating cost forecast are supplied.
